verdict.rationale: Pulumi ESC can act as an OIDC provider that issues short-lived, signed tokens, which AWS, Azure and Google Cloud exchange for temporary credentials. That is the product's own way of minting ephemeral credentials an agent could use. The evidence does not show those credentials being scoped to least privilege, and nothing describes scoped Pulumi Cloud API tokens or any agent-specific credential feature. missing for 10: scoped/least-privilege Pulumi API tokens for agents, documented permission scoping on issued credentials, agent-specific credential issuance, independent or hands-on corroboration
